name: Tool Pre-filter
description: Dynamic two-stage skill and tool pre-filtering using decision models to reduce context overhead and eliminate tool hallucinations.

thresholdAnyTool.description: Probability threshold below which all tool schemas are stripped for pure conversational turns.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for the decision model evaluation.

enabled.label: Enable Semantic Tool Filtering
enabled.help: When enabled, uses the configured Decision Model to strip unneeded tool schemas before calling the primary LLM.

thresholdAnyTool.label: Tool Need Threshold
thresholdAnyTool.help: Requests with a tool-need probability below this value are treated as pure conversation, saving context tokens.
